第9章 副职业的纠结
1周第6日.
我们可爱的主角决定开始攒兵了。
“建造人族2阶靶场－2000！招募弓箭手40名，－800！”
“建造精灵族2阶矮人洞穴－2000！招募矮人40名，－800！”剩余43800金。
2阶的人类弓箭手，实力相当于剑魔大陆3级战士。沿用了英雄无敌3的造型，1米7左右的身高，头戴铁盔，身披硬皮甲，手执英格兰长弓（不会吧？），背着一个插满铁箭的皮制箭壶，足蹬牛皮靴，眼神如鹰般锐利。一眼即知，他们是百战余生的冷静射手。有一个散射特性。
散射：经验丰富的射手知道什么时候，该选择什么方式攻击。一次对一个小范围内射出3只箭矢，无法保证命中率，伤害减少30%。
这显然是用来对敌人密集阵型，做火力覆盖，无差别攻击时的特技，跟平时的精确打击可以相互配合使用。
精灵族的矮人也是2阶的，只有1米1的身高确实跟他们的名称匹配很高，沿用了英雄无敌3的造型，也与大陆的矮人种族非常类似，刀削的脸搭配粗旷的长胡须，身披重型铁甲，手里操着的大板斧和其超短的大粗腿，同样让人印象深刻。拥有特性抗魔。
抗魔：减少战士所受魔法伤害的50%。
很好的肉盾兵种，可惜速度太慢了。缺点与优先同样突出的战士。
这里其实精灵族2阶是可以招募剑舞者的，不过按照某游戏苦手的记忆，这种无甲兵种，在英雄无敌5里，基本是属于边缘职业，不如矮人的强力肉盾来的实在。
林天继续在魔兽森林外围肆虐，包场刷怪，就要耐的住寂寞。我们的宅男认为自己这方面的修养很高，高手寂寞，所以习惯了寂寞的人，更容易成就高手。
依然秉承效率为王的某宅，拿出了魔兽世界公测时，10天冲45级封顶的干劲来，可劲的刷怪。一条条无辜的生命转变成了他手里的经验。依然是坚持只杀3级以下的魔兽，较小的消耗配上蓝瓶的补给，林天成了疯狂的经验永动机……
某宅正在与一只，身上会喷火的3级野牛战斗，突然传来提示音。
提示：在与敌人战斗的过程中，英雄的初级鹰眼术发挥了作用，习得献祭术。
毫不客气的干掉这头野牛老师，查看新学习的献祭术，这是1个3级火系魔法，就是从刚才的战斗中，鹰眼术发挥了其10%的几率偷学到的，并没有归入英雄无敌魔法术之中，而是划入了副职业火魔法师的魔法体系之中。这让林天对自己的发展潜力有了深一层的了解。将有限的时间，发挥到无限的杀怪练级中去吧……
又一只3级的风狐倒在了林天小火球的淫威之下。
提示：英雄骑士等级提升4，攻击+1，请选择一项能力：初级启蒙术，中级智慧术，初级战争机械！
初级启蒙术：经验值获取增加1%，每次升级有1%机会的额外机会获得一点属性。

这个技能虽然看起来不错，但实际增加量很少，按系统给出的说明，即使到了后期升级到宗师级，也不过是少少的经验值增加5%，和每级5%的机会额外获得一点属性，要占用一个宝贵的能力位，显得有些鸡肋了，以后再说吧。
中级智慧术可以学习2阶魔法，暂时可以放放，毕竟初级智慧术在手，宗师级就绝对跑不了。毕竟学完12项能力，每项能力再提升4次到宗师级，也不过就是60级左右的事。
初级战争机械：使英雄能够携带战争机械进行作战。
就选这个！记忆中英雄可以携带投石车，弩车，急救帐篷和弹药车等战争机械进行战斗。这四种机械都很强力，不过刚才林天在查看弓箭手属性时，就特意留了个心眼，但愣是没有找到关于弹药数的说法，这说明系统取消了射手类生物的弹药限制。从这点上看，弹药车基本算是废了。但这仍不能阻止某宅选择这个能力的决心，因为剩下的3种机械，任意一种能力都是非常诱人的。
投石车可以砸城墙，就算用来砸兵有点大炮拍蚊子的感觉，但那个威慑力也绝对不容小视，攻城掠地居家旅行必备。
弩车强大的射程，巨大的杀伤力，那也绝对是霸气外泄。穿透力也是非常可观，与投石车简直就是黄金搭档。
急救帐篷虽然防御力很差，但放在后排可以自动治疗受伤的士兵，貌似英雄无敌5里高级了还能放毒，再说了，帐篷在野外这么一放，野战也是很有情趣的，嘿嘿！
我们委琐的主角又开始无节操的YY了：顶级三发巨型投石车，顶级三连火焰连弩车，顶级施毒帐篷救人杀人两不误，哇哈哈。
提示：副职业等级提升为4，hp提升为140点，mp提升为140点，学会4级魔法大火球。
副职业的飞速提升，宅男乙虽然确实很高兴，毕竟这是自己实力的表现，但仅仅不到一个星期，他就从1级魔法学徒，升级为4级。这种速度让某宅心中不由有点忐忑：这副职业剑魔大陆的魔法师，等级是不是提升的太快了？会不会被系统缩水了？
现在就已经是中级魔法师了，对应就是4级骑兵的实力，这在大陆上已经算实力不低了。要是按照这个速度，5级升到高级魔法师（对应5级骑士），6级升到大魔法师（对应6级将军），7级升到魔导士（对应7级名将），8级升到大魔导师（对应8级大剑师），9级升到法圣（对应9级剑圣），难道我升到10级时，也能升到10级圣者的阶段吗？那我10级以后难道真要逆天修神不成？
其实这里我们纯洁的主角误会了，系统当然会对这个做限制，实际上主职业到6级，副职业会同时升到6级大魔法师的水准；但要到10级才会升级到7级魔导士，20级到8级大魔导师，30级到9级法圣，40级才能到10级圣者。
然后……然后就没有然后了，系统估计是内存不足，是不可能有空间融合修仙模块的。
逆天，那是不可能的！

Chapter 9 The tangle of sub-career
6th day of week 1.
Our lovable protagonist decides to start gathering troops.
"Build a human level 2 shooting range -2000! Recruit 40 archers, -800!"
"Build the level 2 dwarf cave of the elves - 2000! Recruit 40 dwarves, -800!" There is 43,800 gold left.
A level 2 human archer is equivalent to a level 3 warrior from the Sword Demon Continent. Following the appearance of Heroes of Might and Magic 3, he is about 1.7 meters tall, wearing an iron helmet and hard leather armor, holding an English longbow (no way?), carrying a leather quiver filled with iron arrows, wearing cowhide boots, and his eyes are as sharp as an eagle. You can tell at a glance that they are clinical shooters who will fight for the rest of their lives. Has a scattering property.
Scatter: Experienced shooters know when and how to attack. Shoots 3 arrows at a time in a small area. The hit rate cannot be guaranteed and the damage is reduced by 30%.
This is obviously a stunt used to cover the enemy's dense formation, cover fire, and attack indiscriminately. It can be used in conjunction with the usual precision strikes.
The dwarves of the elves are also at level 2. Their height of only 1.1 meters really matches their name. They follow the shape of Heroes of Might and Magic 3 and are very similar to the dwarves from the mainland. Their sharp faces are paired with long, rough beards, and they wear heavy iron armor. The big ax they hold in their hands and their super-short thick legs are equally impressive. Has the property of resisting magic.
Anti-magic: Reduces 50% of magic damage received by warriors.
A good tank unit, but too slow. A warrior whose shortcomings are equally prominent as his priorities.
In fact, sword dancers can be recruited by the elves at level 2 here, but according to the memory of a certain gamer, this armor-free unit is basically a marginal profession in Heroes 5 and is not as effective as the powerful human shield of the dwarves.
Lin Tian continued to wreak havoc on the outskirts of the World of Warcraft Forest. He reserved the area to spawn monsters, so he had to endure the loneliness. Our otakus think that they are highly accomplished in this area, and masters are lonely, so people who are used to loneliness are more likely to become masters.
A certain house that still adheres to the principle that efficiency is king has shown the motivation to reach the level 45 cap in 10 days during the open beta of World of Warcraft, and it can spawn monsters with great enthusiasm. Innocent lives turned into experiences in his hands. Still insisting on only killing monsters below level 3, with a small consumption and the supply of blue bottles, Lin Tian became a crazy experience perpetual motion machine...
A certain house was fighting a level 3 bison that breathed fire when a notification sound suddenly came from the house.
Tip: During the battle with the enemy, the hero's primary Eagle Eye technique comes into play and he learns the Sacrifice Technique.
He killed the buffalo teacher unceremoniously and checked the newly learned sacrifice spell. This was a level 3 fire spell. It was learned secretly from the eagle eye spell with a 10% chance in the previous battle. It was not included in the heroic invincibility spell, but was included in the magic system of the sub-professional fire mage. This gave Lin Tian a deeper understanding of his development potential. Use your limited time to unlimited monster killing and leveling up...
Another level 3 wind fox fell under the power of Lin Tian's small fireball.
Tip: The level of the heroic knight increases by 4, and the attack +1. Please choose an ability: primary enlightenment, intermediate wisdom, primary war machine!
Elementary Enlightenment: Experience gained increases by 1%, and there is an additional 1% chance of gaining an attribute each time you upgrade.
Although this skill looks good, the actual increase is very small. According to the instructions given by the system, even if you upgrade to the master level in the later stage, it will only increase the experience value by 5%, and there will be a 5% chance of gaining an additional attribute at each level. It takes up a precious ability slot, which seems a bit useless. Let’s talk about it later.
Intermediate Wisdom can learn level 2 magic, so you can put it aside for the time being. After all, if you have the primary Wisdom in hand, the Grandmaster level will definitelyCan't run. After all, after learning 12 abilities, each ability will be upgraded 4 times to the master level, which is only around level 60.
Primary War Machine: Enables the hero to carry war machines into battle.
Just choose this one! The memory hero can carry war machinery such as catapults, ballistae, first aid tents and ammunition carts into battle. These four machines are very powerful, but when Lin Tian checked the attributes of the archers just now, he paid special attention to them, but he couldn't find anything about the number of ammunition. This shows that the system has canceled the ammunition limit for archer creatures. From this point of view, the ammunition truck is basically useless. But this still cannot stop a certain house from deciding to choose this ability, because any of the remaining three machines has very attractive abilities.
Catapults can smash city walls. Even if they are used to smash soldiers, they feel like cannons swatting mosquitoes, but their deterrence should not be underestimated. They are a must-have for sieges and plundering territory at home and on trips.
The ballista's powerful range and huge lethality definitely reveal its domineering power. The penetrating power is also very impressive, and it is a golden partner with the catapult.
Although the first-aid tent has poor defense, it can automatically treat injured soldiers when placed in the back row. It seems that in Heroes 5, it is more advanced and can release poison. Besides, if the tent is placed like this in the wild, field battles are also very interesting, hehe!
Our trivial protagonist started to engage in unscrupulous YY again: the top three-shot giant trebuchet, the top three-fire continuous ballista, the top poisoning tent that can save people and kill people, hahaha.
Tips: Increase the sub-career level to 4, HP to 140 points, MP to 140 points, and learn the level 4 magic fireball.
Although Otaku B is indeed very happy about the rapid improvement of his sub-profession, after all, it is a manifestation of his own strength, but in less than a week, he was upgraded from level 1 magic apprentice to level 4. This speed makes a certain house feel a little uneasy: Is this professional magician from the Sword Demon Continent rising in level too fast? Will it be shrunk by the system?
Now he is an intermediate magician, corresponding to the strength of a level 4 cavalry, which is already considered to be quite powerful on the mainland. If at this rate, level 5 is promoted to senior magician (corresponding to level 5 knight), level 6 is promoted to great magician (corresponding to level 6 general), level 7 is promoted to magician (corresponding to level 7 famous general), level 8 is promoted to great mage (corresponding to level 8 great swordsman), and level 9 is promoted to mage saint (corresponding to level 9 sword master), will I be able to reach the stage of saint when I reach level 10? Then after level 10, will I really want to defy heaven and become a god?
In fact, our innocent protagonist here has misunderstood. The system will of course impose restrictions on this. In fact, when the main profession reaches level 6, the secondary profession will be upgraded to the level of a level 6 great magician at the same time; but it will not be upgraded to a level 7 magician until level 10, a level 20 to level 8 great magician, a level 30 to a 9th level magic saint, and a level 40 to reach a 10th level saint.
Then... then there is no more. The system is probably running out of memory, and it is impossible to have a space fusion cultivation module.
Damn it, that's impossible!
